slice.action: Inspected the official Cargo test/documentation matches for --versioned-dirs and --no-delete at the pinned Cargo revision, without executing Cargo or inspecting any dependency repository.
slice.finding: The official documentation states that --versioned-dirs makes all vendor subdirectories versioned to make vendored history easier to track. The official vendor tests include --versioned-dirs cases that assert expected versioned paths/content, and a separate --no-delete test exists. In the exact inspected matches, no test combined an already-existing version-suffixed registry package containing an extra stale internal file with a rerun of cargo vendor and asserted whether that extra file is preserved, rejected, or cleaned. Therefore this slice does not establish a test- or documentation-specified stale-internal-file guarantee for the reuse fast path.
slice.negative_evidence_scope: Exact search/read scope only: official rust-lang/cargo pinned revision, cargo vendor docs, and tests/testsuite/vendor.rs matches for --versioned-dirs and --no-delete. This is not a repository-wide proof that no such test exists under any wording or at other revisions.
